key_points: Wynn hit a new 52-week low on Sep 22, reflecting short-term pressure.
Stock opened up ~2% on Sep 22 after the low, indicating some buying interest.
Truist notes Wynn outperforming MGM and Caesars in November outlook.
Bank of America took a $74.5M position in Wynn, signaling institutional confidence.
Overall signals are mixed, suggesting limited near-term impact.
